neighbours.label: the token ' up' as a direction of upward motion or rising
fire: The kite climbed up into the grey sky.
Startled by the noise, the cat jumped up onto the shelf.
From the valley, smoke drifted up toward the peaks.
The hikers slowly climbed up the steep rocky trail.
She glanced up from her book when the door opened.
Bubbles rose up through the water of the tank.
With a grunt he lifted the box up over his head.
The rocket shot up and vanished behind the clouds.
quiet: The kite tumbled down into the grey sea.
Startled by the noise, the cat hid under the shelf.
From the valley, smoke drifted toward the distant town.
The hikers slowly descended the steep rocky trail.
She glanced down at her book when the door opened.
Bubbles sank lazily through the dark water of the tank.
With a grunt he dropped the box onto the floor.
The rocket fell back and crashed behind the hills.

notes: ' up' dominates the top 32 (x22), mostly physical upward motion (went up, looked up, throw up). Probe: 'floated up' 0.37, 'went up' (prices) 0.26, 'set up' 0.005, 'down' 0.02.
